summary: Parked-on residential kerb at the flat top, but homes 16-18 m away.
reasons: Flat only near the top end

best_section.where: Top (west) end of the south kerb, before the street bends

drivers.seclusion: Apartments (Beauty Point 16 m) and detached houses (18 m) on this side; more homes across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with cars parked along the kerb; room to stop in the parking lane.
drivers.convention: Several cars parked along this kerb, so a van is less conspicuous.

flags: Steep overall: about 12% mean, 18% max; flat only at 85-105 m
sun_shade: Mostly open at the best section; some tree shade on the south side.
